meta.description: Hard Stop decision table (P4 client). P5 adds cases only. Trades use DB-style keys (account_id); before/after use client Trade field names (see fieldToColumn). isFallback cases are client-only (server uses UTC for a NULL tz). status 'off' maps to enforced=false on the server. P5 fix leg: cases 67-69 (percent limit <= 0 is off; decimal-percent boundary where client float and server numeric differ, see sidecar serverExpected).

at-80: warn, add allowed

hardstop-add-bypass: winning trade blocked when locked
hardstop-add-bypass: add without date uses now
add for a past trading day allowed while today locked

edit notes allowed when locked
edit tags (setup/confluences/emotion/mistake/checklist) allowed when locked

full-field patch, minute-truncated date (seconds lost) on locked day blocked
full-field patch, minute-truncated date equal to stored date allowed
legacy lowercase asset + notes edit: no false diff
riskIsEstimated flip on locked day allowed (D-4)
screenshotFile set on locked day allowed
screenshotFile null (remove image) on locked day allowed
risk null -> 100 on locked day blocked (no Number(null) trap)
risk 100 -> null on locked day blocked

date move out of locked day blocked

past-day trade pnl edit allowed while today locked
hardstop-delete-bypass: delete losing trade blocked
past-day trade delete allowed while today locked

warn while enableHardStop off (D-9)

maxDailyLoss 0: not configured

dailyLossAlertThreshold 50: ok at 40%

UTC+7 00:30: yesterday 23:59 local loss does not count

isFallback (client-only): prefs not loaded -> fail OPEN

isFallback (client-only): loaded but tz invalid -> fallback zone

P5 EU DST 2026-03-29 Berlin: 00:30 CET loss counts for the new day, add blocked
P5 EU DST 2026-10-25 Berlin: 23:30 CEST (Oct 24, before the 03:00 switch) previous-day loss does not count

P5 US DST 2026-11-01 reset 17:00 ET: 17:00:00.000 is the new day, unlocks
P5 only resetTz (no resetTime): day is midnight in the override zone

P5 broken resetTime 25:99 falls back to 00:00

P5 percent decimal limit (3% of 10000.10) below the limit: warn

P5 dailyLossAlertThreshold null falls back to 80: warn at 80%
